body:
The expanded Milestone 5 includes physical-device qualification, actual DICOMKit integration and stable publication. This preparation adds a separate physical Watch evidence verifier and capture procedure, and aligns VERSION, CLI output/help and the manual to the intended `1.1.0` release. Current documentation keeps the expanded scope in progress and preserves the earlier simulator-only completion receipt as dated history.

The verifier requires six unique physical Watch Release records, zero failures/skips, matching hardware/OS/source identity, capture-time log/bundle bindings and preservation of the original xcresult. Eleven focused parser, provenance and rejection controls pass, including rejection of the retained genuine simulator run. Signing and the first genuine hardware capture remain unexecuted.

This PR uses the frozen `codex/milestone-5-release-baseline-87bc4e9` base at `87bc4e9f99ddaf8c592ec9dfe09120c043a768ff`, the completed preparation head from PR #26. Library implementation and Package.swift still match `f548e5048e5c71204c2a2ec4036bf66c4f040285`; library tests, Watch harness, existing simulator verifier and all seven common contract documents remain unchanged. The CLI changes are version/help metadata only. Subsequent evidence-only commits preserve the tested shipping revision `7739dba554cabebcc25e3593af3feb6ba27f8489`.

Validation:

- Native macOS Swift 6.4.2 explicit Swift Build Release CLI build and all 250 process checks pass, including staged installation and rendered manual checks.
- Fresh GitHub URL consumption at `7739dba` passes clean/incremental Debug and Release builds and both executions. Separate library/CLI derived SBOMs pass official schemas, SPDX SHACL and identity checks. Raw SPDX generator schema failures remain preserved and disclosed; this is exact-revision consumption, not stable-tag resolution.
- [Hosted run 41781795793](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLI/actions/runs/41781795793) passes all 13 jobs at `7739dba`, including native macOS sanitizers and Watch library/six-case Release/strict simulator verification. Later evidence-only commits preserve those shipping bytes; they are not represented as separate full-matrix executions.
- Unchanged DICOMKit `5756e6408a95649b463d4a6408f2957fe1b4c212` passes 54 selected JPEG/managed-ownership test declarations in eight suites with its pinned predecessor dependencies. This is baseline coverage, not successor integration or full consumer qualification.

Exact commands, hashes, exits and limitations are in [the release-completion record](https://github.com/raster-labs/SwiftJLI/blob/codex/milestone-5-release-completion/Documentation/Migration/Qualification/Milestone5/ReleaseCompletion/README.md). The reviewed four-codec inventory records actual managed JPEG-LS support, the managed JPEG API gap, signed JPEG XL adaptation and JPEG 2000 resolution/API constraints. No consumer adapter has been implemented by this preparation.

The owner confirms no physical Watch/iPhone/iPad is available. DICOMKit's coordinated four-codec migration versus explicitly staged SwiftJLI scope remains unresolved; no allocation or platform contract is waived. Private vulnerability reporting is verified enabled. The draft remains open and stable publication remains gated on actual consumer and physical acceptance. No stable tag, release, merge or consumer cutover is performed by this preparation.
title: Prepare physical Watch verification and SwiftJLI 1.1.0 release metadata
head: codex/milestone-5-release-completion
